levels.text: After using Blink you cannot take lethal damage for 1 second

name: Void Barrier
notes: Damage still lands, but it cannot take you below 1 mana. The engine has an unused modifier for exactly this on health, Modifiers::UnlethalDamage (Player.as:475 caps the hit at current health - 1); with Living Mana the same cap would apply to the mana pool.
summary: After using Blink you cannot take lethal damage for 1 second
